---
name: plan-request-update
description: Create a plan of implementation steps for a given request based on its acceptance criteria and comments.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
## Plan Update
Plan the implementation steps marked as (+++) in the request.
Add this new plan to the implementation steps.
If there are no implementation steps marked as (+++), indicate that no new plan is required.
If there are still tasks remaining to be done in the plan, analyze dependencies and rearrange order accordingly.
If all tasks are done, add a new section at the end of the plan as a new phase.

## Request Update
At the end replace the request steps marked as (+++) with a normal (-)
